W4_implementations.name: Sinkhorn-based OT Credit Assignment
W4_implementations.context: Uses Sinkhorn algorithm with entropy regularization (lambda=0.1) to efficiently compute optimal transport between agent action distributions and reward signals.

extends_rho.mechanism: Entropy regularization reduces OT computation from O(n^3) to O(n^2) while maintaining differentiable solution
extends_rho.tradeoff: Introduces bias in the transport plan proportional to regularization strength

improves_rho.mechanism: OT distance provides geometrically meaningful credit distribution compared to scalar baseline subtraction
improves_rho.tradeoff: Requires well-defined cost metric between agents and rewards

W5_code.name: sinkhorn_credit_assignment
W5_code.context: Computes Sinkhorn distance between agent Q-values and reward, uses gradient as credit signal.

W5_code.name: ot_solver_entropy_reg
W5_code.context: Wraps ott-jax Sinkhorn solver with entropy regularization for stable gradient computation.

W4_implementations.name: Monte Carlo Shapley Credit
W4_implementations.context: Approximates Shapley values via Monte Carlo sampling over agent coalitions, using per-agent value function evaluation.

improves_rho.mechanism: Monte Carlo sampling reduces coalition enumeration from O(2^n) to O(m * n) where m is sample count

W5_code.name: mc_shapley_credit
W5_code.context: Samples random agent permutations to estimate Shapley values, computes marginal contribution for each.
